title: 学术常用词（下）
goal: 掌握因果、评价和结构方面的学术常用词，并根据已给字母补全词形。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 阅读

points.label: 认识本课的学术常用词

body.p: 本课列出另外 60 个学术常用词，分为三组：因果和关系、描述和评价、结构和功能。关系词连同后面的介词一起学，如 depend on。评价词要看清它判断的程度。

body.box: The result depends on several factors. The system contains distinct components.

body.p: depend on 表示依赖，factor 表示影响结果的因素。distinct 表示可区分的，component 表示组成部分。likely 表示可能，不是一定。

cards.title: 词汇表：因果和关系
rows: identify the cause of a delay
a factor affecting the final choice
contribute to a rise in attendance
The delay may result in higher costs.
A loose connection can lead to failure.
relate the diagram to the description
The schedule depends on equipment availability.
the influence of temperature on the material
link each response to a participant
associate a symbol with a sound
connect the two sections of pipe
The handle enables the operator to lift the lid.
prevent dust from entering the case
The records support the proposed explanation.
explain the difference between the results
The arrow indicates the direction of flow.
determine the distance between two points
The task involves sorting several kinds of documents.

cards.title: 词汇表：描述和评价
rows: a complex system with many interacting parts
a major reason for the change
the previous version of the report
a specific date for each observation
a common feature of the samples
Accurate labels are essential for identifying samples.
the equipment available for the test
a likely explanation for the error
a method appropriate for small samples
an efficient use of storage space
a flexible tube that bends without breaking
a potential use for the material

cards.title: 词汇表：结构和功能
rows: the internal structure of a seed
The main function of the cover is protection.
a system for recording loan requests
The cooling process takes several hours.
a distinctive feature of the design
one element of the overall plan
the central region of the image
a thin layer of protective material
the outer surface of the container
a network of paths through the park
the mechanism that opens the gate
a framework for comparing different accounts
the sequence of actions in the procedure
place each object in a category
Water is a limited resource at the site.
the role of the valve in controlling flow

body.box: A loose cable may aff___ the display. The problem is lik___ to return unless the connection is repaired.

body.p: affect 是动词，意思是影响，共 6 个字母，aff___ 补 ect。effect 多作名词，开头是 eff，与已给字母不符。
likely 共 6 个字母，lik___ 补 ely。be likely to 表示某事可能发生。句中的 may 和 likely 都只说可能，没有说问题一定会再出现。

body.box: The readings are consistent, but they are not accurate: the same error occurs each time.

body.p: consistent 指多次读数彼此一致。accurate 指读数符合实际数值。同一个错误每次都出现时，读数一致，但不准确。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The protective cover prevents dust from reaching the sensor.

items.stem: Which phrase best expresses prevents in this sentence?
options: Gives a reason for a change
items.why: 依据 prevents dust from reaching the sensor，prevent 表示阻止，改写为 stops something from happening。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: Only information relevant to the disputed date was included in the report.

items.stem: Which phrase is closest in meaning to relevant here?
items.why: 依据是 relevant to the disputed date：报告只收录与这个日期有关的信息。第二项 connected with 改写了 relevant to。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The boundary separates the managed woodland from the surrounding fields.

items.stem: What does boundary mean in this context?
options: The dividing edge of an area
items.why: 依据 separates the managed woodland from the surrounding fields，boundary 表示区域分界，改写为 dividing edge。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The pulley enables a worker to raise the load with less effort.

items.stem: Which phrase best expresses enables in this sentence?
items.why: 依据 to raise the load with less effort，enable 表示使某人能够完成动作，改写为 makes a worker able。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The container has a flexible wall that bends under slight pressure.

items.why: 依据是 bends under slight pressure，flexible 在这里指可弯曲。第二项是 flexible 用于安排、计划时的意思，与本句不符。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The early drawings and later photographs show two distinct designs, not variations of a single design.

items.stem: Which phrase best expresses distinct here?
items.why: 依据 not variations of a single design，distinct 表示可明确区分，改写为 clearly different from each other。

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: An exhibition explains how an automatic door operates. The sys{tem} contains several parts. One comp{onent} detects movement, while a motor opens the door. The func{tion} of a second sensor is to stop the door from closing on an object. This safety fea{ture} helps pre{vent} contact with visitors. The diagram shows the sequ{ence} of actions. A spec{ific} color marks each signal. The explanation is appro{priate} for visitors without technical training. Clear labels are esse{ntial} because several parts look sim{ilar}.
notes: system：system 表示由多个部分构成的系统。
component：component 表示其中一个部件。
function：function 表示第二个传感器的功能。
feature：feature 表示安全方面的特征。
prevent：prevent contact 表示防止接触。
sequence：sequence 表示动作发生的顺序。
specific：specific 表示每个信号使用特定颜色。
appropriate：appropriate for 表示适合所述观众。
essential：essential 表示清晰标签不可缺少。
similar：similar 表示几个部件外观相似。

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: A robotics class builds a device that sorts wooden blocks. The sys{tem} contains several compo{nents}, including a camera and a moving arm. The camera has a spec{ific} position above the tray. Its func{tion} is to identify shapes. The arm follows a fixed sequ{ence} of movements. This pro{cess}, or series of actions, places each block in a box. The task dep{ends} on light for the camera, so a lamp is avai{lable} beside the tray. A flex{ible} cable bends as the arm moves. Repeated trials produce consi{stent} results, with each shape going to the same box.

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The revised method uses less electricity to complete the same task in the same time. It is more efficient.

items.stem: Which phrase best explains efficient in this context?
options: Using fewer resources for the same work
Containing fewer parts than earlier designs
Being easier to describe in a written report
Being suitable for every possible condition
items.why: 依据 uses less electricity to complete the same task in the same time，efficient 表示以较少资源完成同样工作。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The previous account was written before the newly discovered letter became available.

items.stem: Which phrase is closest in meaning to previous here?
items.why: 依据是 before the newly discovered letter became available，previous 指时间上较早，即第三项。第二项 Less accurate 原文没有说。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The proposed use is only potential; no one has yet tested whether the material will work that way.

items.stem: What does potential mean in this sentence?
items.why: 依据 no one has yet tested whether the material will work that way，potential 表示有可能，但还没有证实。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The material has a layered structure, with thin sheets arranged one above another.

items.stem: What does structure refer to in this sentence?
options: The reason the material was selected
The region where the material was found
The task performed by the material
The arrangement of parts within the material
items.why: 依据 thin sheets arranged one above another，structure 表示内部组成部分的排列方式。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The display indicates the direction of travel by showing an arrow.

items.stem: Which verb is closest in meaning to indicates here?
items.why: 依据是 by showing an arrow，indicate 指显示、指出，与 shows 同义。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The course involves drawing plans, building models, and comparing the finished designs.

items.stem: Which verb is closest in meaning to involves here?
items.why: 依据后列的 drawing plans、building models 和 comparing，involve 表示包含这些活动，includes 与之同义。
